Explore the latest island flight destinations with Saudia

Discover crystal turquoise waters, pristine sandy beaches, and hidden paradises across our global network of island destinations. Experience effortless travel, rich in-flight comfort, and authentic Saudi hospitality as we take you to your next dream island escape.

RSI The Red Sea travel Fly to The Red Sea islands and step onto untouched sands. Book your island escape today and trade everyday routines for vibrant coral reefs, breathtaking sunsets, and unforgettable coastal luxury.
MLE Maldives travel Fly to the Maldives and wake up to endless ocean horizons. Plan the ultimate island vacation filled with bright blue lagoons, quiet beaches, and peaceful moments under the tropical sun.
MRU Mauritius travel Fly to Mauritius and let lush landscapes take your breath away. Start your island trip by exploring emerald waters, warm sands, and vibrant coastal nature that will inspire you.
DPS Bali travel Fly to Bali and immerse yourself in tropical beauty. Secure your island getaway and dive into a world of lush green terraces, golden beaches, and gentle ocean breezes.
HKT Phuket travel Fly to Phuket and land in a world of bright colors and warm waters. Plan an unforgettable island vacation packed with hidden coves, lively coastlines, and relaxing ocean sounds.
JMK Mykonos travel Fly to Mykonos and wander through bright white streets by the sea. Book your next island trip and enjoy sparkling ocean views, warm Mediterranean breezes, and picture-perfect coastlines.
EJH Amalla travel Fly to Amalla and discover a space completely dedicated to your well-being. Start an inspiring island escape where clear waters, quiet shores, and mindful moments rejuvenate your spirit.
ATH Athens travel Fly to Athens and unlock the gateway to the Mediterranean. Journey beyond the historic center to discover sun-drenched coastal escapes, bright waters, and effortless access to breathtaking island trips.
BKK Bangkok travel Fly to Bangkok and launch into a vibrant tropical adventure. Trade the dynamic city energy for easy connections to warm shores, clear waters, and the ultimate Thai island vacation.
KUL Kuala Lumpur travel Fly to Kuala Lumpur and begin your journey to pristine waters. Start your island getaway by connecting to stunning local beaches, lush coastlines, and bright, sun-filled shores.
MNL Manila travel Fly to Manila and open the door to thousands of vibrant shores. Take off on an unforgettable island escape filled with endless ocean views, hidden lagoons, and brilliant white sand beaches.
SIN Singapore travel Fly to Singapore and experience a green city by the sea. Journey to nearby coastal retreats or simply enjoy the lush, tropical island vacation vibe right in the heart of the city.
CGK Jakarta travel Fly to Jakarta and connect to countless vibrant archipelagos. Start your island trip and trade city rhythms for endless horizons, clear warm waters, and peaceful ocean breezes.
BCN Barcelona travel Fly to Barcelona and enjoy the perfect mix of city life and seaside calm. Step right onto bright beaches or catch a quick connection to a stunning Mediterranean island getaway.
FCO Rome travel Fly to Rome and experience an unforgettable Italian adventure. Beyond the city, discover effortless access to bright coastal waters, scenic shores, and inspiring Mediterranean island escapes.

                              Benefits of Booking Your Island Getaway with Saudia

                              Start your vacation in the sky and enjoy the warmth of Saudi hospitality on your journey to paradise. Relax with spacious seating, authentic Saudi cuisine, convenient schedules, generous baggage allowances, and world-class service.

                              Travel Essentials when Packing for Your Island Escape

                              Get ready to soak up the sun. Pack your bags with these tropical must-haves and step into your island getaway with effortless style and ultimate comfort.

                              • Breathable Linens: Beat the tropical heat using lightweight, high-quality cotton tops and comfortable shorts.
                              • Swimwear: Pack your favorite swimsuits and a quick-drying coverup to enjoy the crystal waves.
                              • Sun Protection: Protect your eyes and skin with polarized sunglasses, a wide-brimmed hat, and reliable sunscreen.
                              • Tropical Footwear: Bring comfortable sandals for beach walks and durable water shoes to explore hidden shorelines.
                              • Evening Resort Wear: Slip into elegant yet easy outfits to dine by the ocean after a beautiful day outside.

                              Stopover flights to Island Destinations from Anywhere in the World

                              Explore our Stopover offer and seamlessly turn one vacation into two. Spend up to 96 hours exploring the dynamic streets of Riyadh, the historic coastal charm of Jeddah, or the breathtaking ancient landscapes of AlUla; all easily accessible with a complimentary transit visa.

                              FAQs

                              Islands Getaways

                              Make planning your island trip as enjoyable as the vacation itself. Read our answers to common questions and prepare for the perfect island escape.

                              When is the best time for an island getaway?

                              Chase the sun year round. Tropical destinations peak between November and April for the ideal weather. Check local forecasts, as some regions experience beautiful sunny days long into the summer months depending on their unique climate.

                              How much does an island trip usually cost?

                              Your budget depends entirely on your travel style. Factor in flights, accommodation, local transport, and activities.

                              Do I need travel insurance for an island trip?

                              Protect your peace of mind. We highly recommend securing travel insurance that covers water sports and unexpected medical emergencies before you travel.

                              Can I book a multi-city flight itinerary to visit more than one island destination (island-hopping)?

                              Absolutely. Use our multi-city booking feature to build the ultimate tropical itinerary. Fly into one coastal hub and fly out of another so you never have to see the same sunset twice.

                              How long do I need to book an island escape for?

                              Plan for three to seven days. A long weekend is perfect for a quick ocean retreat, while a full week gives you plenty of time to master water sports and fully immerse yourself in the relaxed coastal lifestyle.

                              What should I do if I have a long layover on my way to my island getaway?

                              Unwind in our premium AlFursan lounges between flights. For longer layovers in Saudi Arabia, apply for a Stopover visa with your flight to step outside the airport, enjoy the beautiful weather, and explore Saudi Arabia's rich culture.
